characters.name: 谢拉·L·格林伍德
characters.description: 谢拉·L·格林伍德是精灵族少女，也是故事的女主角之一。她与豹人族的蕾姆共同使用召唤术召来迪亚布罗，希望借助力量获得自由。召唤魔法被迪亚布罗的戒指反弹后，两人反而成为他的奴隶。谢拉后来被揭示拥有精灵王族身份，是一位公主。她在异世界与迪亚布罗、蕾姆同行，参与对抗魔王军和其他威胁的冒险。

source.name_native: シェラ・L・グリーンウッド
source.description:
Shera L. Greenwood is one of the female protagonists of the series. She is an Elf who is one of the two Summoners who summoned [Diablo](https://anilist.co/character/126793/Diablo). The reason she summoned him was to have the strength to live free.

~!It was revealed later that she was actually an elven princess.!~

characters.name: 迪亚布罗
characters.description: 迪亚布罗的现实身份是坂本拓真，他是网络游戏Cross Reverie的资深玩家，操控着被称为“真正魔王”的角色迪亚布罗。凭借强力装备和技能，他曾轻松击败其他玩家。某天他被召唤到异世界，并以游戏角色的身体醒来。谢拉和蕾姆试图用奴隶魔术控制他，却被戒指反弹，反而成为他的奴隶。迪亚布罗常用魔王般的言行掩饰自己不擅社交的一面。

source.description: Takuma Sakamoto (Sakamoto Takuma) a.k.a. Diablo (gamer tag: @Diablo-13) is the male protagonist of the series. He was a Cross Reverie player who controlled the character Diablo, known as the true Demon King. He always defeated players with better equipment and overwhelming skills, always holding back for being too strong. But one day he was invoked in another world, reincarnating in the body of his character, Diablo, finding two girls, a Pantherian and an elf, who claimed to have invoked him and that he should be a slave to one of them but due to his ring the magic back against them becoming slaves.

characters.name: 蕾姆·加留
characters.description: 蕾姆·加留是豹人族少女，也是故事的女主角之一。她成为召唤术使用者后以冒险者身份行动，并立志消灭魔王克雷布斯库尔姆。蕾姆体内封印着克雷布斯库尔姆的灵魂，这道封印由她的祖先经母亲一代代传下；如果蕾姆死亡，魔王的灵魂就会被释放。她与谢拉一起召唤迪亚布罗，之后三人共同面对魔王军和封印相关的危机。

source.description:
Rem Galleu is one of the female protagonists of the series. She is a Pantherian who became an invoker and had no choice but to become an adventurer and continue to demonstrate its strength, saying to aim to exterminate the Demon King Krebskulm. 

~!It is later revealed that the soul of Krebskulm is sealed in her body and in case she dies the soul will be released.!~

characters.name: 露玛琪娜·韦斯特利亚
characters.description: 露玛琪娜·韦斯特利亚是神圣诸神教会的大神官。她着手调查信众针对教会欺诈、腐败及其他不当行为的投诉，因此遭到圣骑士格瓦尔特追捕并被迫逃亡。露玛琪娜的调查触及教会权力核心，使她成为刺杀目标。她与迪亚布罗一行相遇后寻求保护，也希望借助他们查明教会内部的问题。她的故事线把冒险队伍卷入教会势力之间的冲突。

source.description: **Lumachina Weselia** is the High priest of the church of the divine beings. She is introduced being hunted down by Paladin Gewalt for assassination because she dared investigate complaints of fraud, corruption, and other unpleasantness from the Church Of Divine Beings.

characters.name: 埃德尔嘉德
characters.description: 埃德尔嘉德是一名恶魔族少女，身材矮小，外表秀丽。她有棕色皮肤，皮肤表面带着类似鳞片的质感，银色长发垂至腰间，金色眼睛则呈现爬行动物般的竖缝瞳孔。她的五官和神态带有明显的孩子气，与身上的恶魔特征形成反差。埃德尔嘉德出现在迪亚布罗一行与魔族势力相关的故事线中，是具有独特外形特征的恶魔族人物。

source.description:
She is a short and beautiful demonic girl with brown skin (with the skin surface seeming like scales), long silver hair that reaches to her waist, and big golden eyes that have vertically torn pupils like that of a reptile with childish ambiance being felt from them.

(Source: How Not to Summon a Demon Lord Wiki)

characters.name: 梅
characters.description: 梅是“安心旅馆”的看板娘，负责接待来店住宿的客人。面对顾客时，她表现得活泼随和；遇到不守规矩的客人，则会显露出强硬的一面。只要对方付费，她不会因人类、豹人、恶魔或堕落者等种族区别对待，也不会干涉客人在房间里的私事；但她要求客人不得打扰邻居或损坏旅馆财物。梅重视旅馆经营秩序，待客原则明确。

source.description:
She is the Peace of Mind Inn's idol.

She exhibits an energetic happy-go-lucky persona when interacting with guests but can give out a threatening persona to put unruly people in their place. As long as she's facing a paying customer, she doesn't care about race or origin, whether Human, Pantheran, Demon or even Fallen, it doesn't matter to her. She further doesn't care what customers do in their rooms so long as they don't bother their neighbours, or cause property damage.

~! When Diablo openly declares his intent to "torture" Rem, and Rem objects, rather than be concerned about the torture, she's more concerned over Rem being too loud. !~

characters.name: 克雷布斯库尔姆
characters.description: 克雷布斯库尔姆被称为“灵魂魔王”，是堕落者的统治者。她曾与其他魔王合为一体，后来在与神的战斗中落败，灵魂被封印在蕾姆的祖先体内，并通过母系一代代传承，最终来到蕾姆身上。只要蕾姆死亡，封印便会解除，克雷布斯库尔姆也可能重新现世。她与蕾姆的生命相连，是迪亚布罗一行必须面对的核心魔王威胁。
nicknames: Demon Lord of the Soul Krebskulm

name_alternative: Demon Lord of the Soul Krebskulm
source.description:
《Demon Lord of the Soul, Krebskulm》 is the ruler of the Fallen (Demonic Beings).

~!She was once one being with the other Demon Lords but were split apart after being defeated by God. She was sealed in Rem Galleu's ancestor and was passed down from mother to daughter up to Rem.!~

characters.name: 维乔斯
characters.description: 维乔斯是神圣诸神教会的枢机主教，在教会内部拥有相当大的权力。当大神官露玛琪娜开始调查教会的欺诈与腐败，并质疑教会权威时，维乔斯雇用刺客试图杀死她，以阻止调查继续。他代表教会高层中维护既有权力的势力，与逃亡中的露玛琪娜发生直接冲突，也使迪亚布罗一行卷入教会内部的权力斗争。
